Missing Folders

Do you see only outbox on the accounts with missing folders?

This generally happens when the oauth sign-in step was skipped after importing accounts. Did you press the "later button"? See the screen shot.

The app downloads the imap folder list when it first connects to the server.

Can you perform the below steps to complete the sign-in & validate the server connection.

a) Navigate to... 1. Settings > account name > fetching mail > incoming server 2. Enter password (if used) 3. Tap next 4. Tap the sign-in with provider button (if prompted) and grant the app access to your account. 5. Note any errors if this doesn't complete successfully

b) Navigate to ... 1. Settings > account name > sending mail > outgoing server 2. Enter password (if used) 3. Tap next 4. Note any errors if this doesn't complete successfully

If the steps complete successfully, your account folders should display. Repeat for each account missing folders.

c) You can also try refreshing the folder list. 1. Open the sidebar with account folders shown. 2. Tap manage folders (bottom of list). 3. Tap three dot menu > refresh folder list.

Performance issue

Can you check what value is configured for the local folder size. Navigate to settings > account name > fetching mail > local folder size

The default value is 25. A value of 500 or more is know to slow down the app and make it unstable.

This forum is for the Thunderbird mobile app on Android.

It sounds like your question relates to Thunderbird Desktop on the PC. The credentials it uses to access your email accounts are stored in its own password manager. A single prinary password can be entered to protect access to the password manager.

Please see the guide linked below which includes steps on how to reset the primary password.

https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/protect-your-thunderbird-passwords-primary-password


If you need further support on Thunderbird Desktop, please consider posting within their forum. Experts there are better placed to offer help specific to that version.
